decision.rationale: Use the named UF at the same area role as the other Brazilian states. A single-province federal district is a documented administrative exception, not an invented grouping to reach a quota. Its footprint must be derived from retained location members.

evidence.title: IBGE Brasília membership record
evidence.inspected_fact: Municipality Brasília 5300108 → immediate region Distrito Federal 530001 → intermediate region Distrito Federal 5301 → UF Distrito Federal 53. The current sole location is the same named Brasília source territory.

evidence.title: IBGE UF registry
evidence.inspected_fact: Inspected all 27 UFs; Distrito Federal is UF 53. All other Brazilian state areas already exist, but this area is absent.
